en: We all rush her out of instinct and I wrestle with her arm, forcing it upward as flames start shooting out of it.
S-Shit! That's hot! The t-temperature I mean!
How did she- ah!- did she fix her suit?!
AGH! FUCKERS!
K-Karen! Stop! We're not your enemies!
YOU'RE ALL GOING TO PAY!
She charging fire!!
JENNA! GET AWAY FROM HER!
Karen! Your helmet isn't on! You're not gonna survive!
Neither will you.
I desperately try to wrestle with her, trying to find an off switch... anything...
JENNA! RUN!
I win.
NO! NO! NO!
Phew... HQ disable suit.
Close save! Nice one, Jenna's friend!
Too close...
Karen! W-What did you do to her, HQ?
HQ turn off suit! No fire, no move! Still talk though.
FUCK!! WHY?! WHY WON'T YOU JUST LOSE?! YOU ARROGANT BITCH! LET ME RID MYSELF OF YOU!
Let's... Let's get her somewhere safe... Maybe the room over there...
DON'T FUCKING TOUCH ME!!
Can Rida help?
Rida help carry angry girl.
FUCK YOU! FUCK YOU!
Her arms are locked in an outstretched pose. They don't even move when we move her. She looks frozen in time...
Angry girl heavy.
I think I'll just... go...
Rida go too. Enjoy angry girl, Carcen.
Yup...
Why won't you just fucking kill me?
Aren't you supposed to be killing me?
You always get saved by some stupid fucking bullshit.
Maybe it's fate.
If it was fate, I would have killed you by now. The world will be better without you, you fucking mutt.
I just want to be rid of you... So. Fucking. Bad... You're a constant fucking reminder of all the pain you've caused me.
I can fix it... We can fix it...
You can't fix shit! All you do is break everything you fucking touch! Trying to be a fucking hero!
I'm just trying to help you...
By locking me up and keeping me prisoner? You're not helping.
Just... try to get some sleep... Maybe...
It's sooo bright in heeeeere!
Can't sleep when it's so bright is all.
Hmmm... HQ can fix! Need Jenna help though...
If you're not busy, Jenna...
Fuck are you looking at me for?
No reason...
What do you need me for, HQ?
Need Jenna help so Floria can sleep.
Yes, I know, but I mea-
Wait?! Is it nighttime already?
Crap! I'm late for my patrol shift!
I need to get to Martin! Sorry, blue...
That's... That's okay. We should be fine here. Go do your thing.
Thanks, blue. You're the best.
She leans in and gives me a quick peck on the cheek before rushing off with Throb.
How about a quickie on the way back, Throbbie?
Jenna okay?
I'm alright, bud. What do I need to do?
Take signal detector.
He hands me a weird little device...
It go beep when close to signal! Need Jenna to find signals in walls for HQ to tap... Then HQ can control lights!
Damn... Sounds like a dirty job, but someone's gotta do it.
Mm... HQ wish Jenna luck.
Thanks, bud. I'll take care of it quick. Then we can all do a nice big sleep.
Mm.
Here we are!
Tribe home!
We can make some space here for your tents!
We should ask Lady.
Lady! We did it! Rida is leading her clan again!
Rida top!
Uh huh... Where are they going to stay?
We were thinking of this bit of forest right here.
Yeah! They have their tents and everything!
Tents?
Yeah, they're surprisingly elaborate actually.
Tribe tent Rida design.
... Fine. Just get it done.
Hmm...
Let's get to i-
Argh!
Err... Floria? You alright?
Voices... in my head... Hurts.
Voices...? Like how we heard her voice in Sublevel 2.
Hey Flo, let's get you somewhere you can rest, okay?
O-Okay...
You guys handle the tents. We'll take care of her.
Okay, sounds good.
Tents!
Tents done!
That was pretty quick!
Tribe strong with Rida!
It sure is.
Rida thanks...
You're welcome! You'll be there for us when we need you too.
Trust Rida, trust tribe!
I will.
Hmm, me lost key.
Rida back, tribe strong.
Thanks for bring back Rida.
Your welcome!
Did see the Metalman?
Yes what with Metalman?
Metalman can make strong. Metalman have big cock.
Metalman not from tribe.
And? Me want get strong he can make strong.
(They must talk about Arnold)
Nothing left to do here.
Hmm let's see if we can open it.
Another locked door.
We've gathered everyone. We're ready for the next step.
So it's finally time...
Wait here. I'll gather the others.
Man, there's so many people around the camp now! Place is packed!
Uh. Yeaah! It's friggin' annoying! Tell 'em to stay out of my stuff!
I-It seems t-to be a s-strong fighting f-force!
And that's why we're here now.
To tell people to stay out of my shit?
To discuss our plan to fight.
Which brings us to how much time we have left. The short answer is we have no idea. That tower could go off at any point.
And then we'll all be mindless idiots!
Hey!
Eheh... Sorry.
So we need to come up with a plan of attack quick.
We've already been planning out the resistance's plan of attack. It's just a matter of what the other groups will do.
Can they not just reinforce you guys?
Yeah, and have a bunch of even dumber people try to mess with our gear?
What pink girl say about Rida people?
Surely you don't mean my children.
Guys. We don't have time to be at each other's throats.
I suppose we could use them.
Great! So what's your big plan anyway?
Without getting into the nitty gritty of it, we plan to take and hold the ground floor of the tower so reinforcements can't arrive.
Then we'd need a strike team to make their way up the tower and clear the floors as they go until they get to the top.
The objective is to disable the tower. The main controls seem to be at the top. That's where you'll be able to override the system and shut it down.
Uh- us?
Duh, slacker! I'd do it myself but Lady said-
You're needed on the gr-
On the ground level! Yeah I know!
We can handle it.
Oh yeah? And what's gonna happen when you see your little girlfriend again?
Sof-
What?! Am I the only one here that remembers the way this chick PROTECTED that murdering fire cunt-
E-Erm... Sofie...
And cuz of this bleeding heart over here, that monster forced us out of our home! Don't you all remember how much we lost because of that?
So forgive me if I'm a little nervous about going to fucking war beside someone who won't do what needs to be done!!
Sofie. Enough.
Needs to be done? What the fuck does that mean?
When the chips are down. When it's us or her. Who are you gonna choose?
Yeah. Thought so.
This isn't very productive.
Not another word out of you, Sofie.
Ugh...
Jenna. This goes without saying, but I'm going to say it anyways. It needs to be us. Do you understand?
Yeah. I get it.
Now. There's only the matter of entry left. The tower is protected by a large wall with an energy gate, that gate needs to be unlocked.
E-Erm... It's n-not only t-that gate. I'm p-positive the r-rest of the t-tower has many l-locked entryways inside.
W-We'd need to crack h-hundreds of locks. I-It would take y-years.
We don't have years!
But we've got the fourth month of the year.
... What?
Wow. That's a throwback. I see where blue is going with this.
Do tell?
We had a bit of a run-in with a rogue AI a while ago. She's down at the VR Center in Carceburg. We're on good terms.
Oh, a run-in? That's what you're calling it. Okay.
W-Why... an A-AI could h-handle locks l-like those easily!
Didn't you hear the 'rogue' part?
What's its name?
Like I said! Fourth month of the year!
April!
Wow. That was actually impressive for you Rida. Good job.
Rida smart.
April. Right. Okay. First thing's first then. Tomorrow you're gonna go find this 'April'. Secure it. Then bring it back here and we can begin the attack.
You got it.
Once the attack is underway, you'll take your strike team and get to the top of the tower to disable it before it's too late.
Simple!
Piece of cake!
Rida smart!
What could possibly go wrong...?
That's the spirit!
We'll try to prepare our forces while you get the AI.
Oh yeah! Little bit of training!
We're all gonna die.
Quiet.
Get some rest. We begin at dawn tomorrow.
Right.
(It's almost over...)
(And for what?!)
(Karen's... I know she's still in there... somewhere...)
(But I can't fucking reach her!)
(And with everyone's lives on the line... I might have to...)
(Fuck... Fuck fuck fuck!)
Err... Hey blue.
Hey Jewel...
You uh... havin' trouble sleeping too?
Yeah, I am.
Me too.
What's got you troubled?
Well... I've never been in a battle before.
But we've been in tons of battles together.
Well... Those were more like little fights. This feels... much different, bigger.
Yeah, it can get pretty overwhelming and scary.
The way to deal with it is to just focusing on your part to play.
Our job is to get April. Then we just take the tower. We've been through a bunch together, we can get through this too. Just another day on the job.
"Just take the tower." You make it sound so simple...
Well... I guess there's a bit more to it than that, yeah.
Yeah... Thanks, blue. So what's keeping you up?
Oh- I'm uh... heh... just cold?
Well we could warm up if you wan-
... Am I interrupting?
Only a little.
Hey Stefan.
Oh? Not Throb? We not doing nicknames anymore?
I guess it just didn't feel right to joke.
Well the jokes are one of the reasons why we love ya.
I've got plenty more reasons too.
Thanks.
Can't sleep either, Throb?
Nope. Scared shitless.
Yeah...
But... I'm also ready. Whatever happens, I'll know I did my part to reverse some of the wrongs I've been a part of.
You're not responsible for any of this.
No, but I didn't help. When I was a guard, I just kept my head down for my own selfish ass. The easy life... I'm done keeping my head down.
Well, I know It hasn't just been an easy life for you.
... Yeah. Guess not. But I shouldn't have done the things I did.
I've got regrets too. I'm sorry.
What are you sorry for?
I had a chance to prevent all of this years ago. But I just... couldn't. If I just...
Don't beat yourself up. Let's both make up for what we should've done.
Yeah... Alright.
Lot of heart to hearts going around.
Now's the time for it, I guess.
Oh- Looks like a party in here.
Well it was company, now it's a crowd I guess.
Hey green.
Hey! Rida and I just finished up some 'destressing'. Wanted to see what you guys were up to.
Rida fuck plant girl.
Yeah, we got that.
Eh?? How??
Must be just intuition, big gal.
How are you feeling, Jen?
I'm fine. It'll be a cake walk!
I know that face. You always made it when you had your pre-mission nerves.
I'm just thinking about...
Karen. I know.
I-... Yeah.
Well... You pulled me out of that... mindset I was in. I'm sure we'll be able to do the same with Karen.
Thanks, Flo...
Rida excited for fight!
Guess that makes one of us at least.
Mm. Rida wanted carcens to know. And plant girl too.
You were sure excited a few minutes ago.
Yes!
Hey, why were you hogging her by the way, green? Save some for the rest o-
What the fuck was that?!
Something's wrong...
Rida smell fight.
Fight? But I thought we were starting tomorrow?
Looks like someone didn't get the memo. Let's see what's happening.
(Karen. No...)
Hello again, Wildfire.
What a fucking shithole you have here. You their leader?
I never stopped being their leader.
(Never stopped? What's that supposed to mean?)
You... I remember you. I've broken you before haven't I?
You'll never break me.
That voice... I do remember you. I broke apart your little coup years ago. Made an example out of you.
No wonder you're covered head to toe. I'd hide all those burn marks too.
Like you hide all your marks? Was Pyra too rough again? Mask's back on I see.
SHUT THE FUCK UP! THIS TIME I WON'T LEAVE A SHRED OF YOUR LITTLE RESISTANCE REMAINING. GOOD OF YOU TO ALL GATHER IN ONE PLACE!
Sofie. Get the guns.
I thought you'd never ask.
Oh great, the slacker's here.
Jenna! Get out of here! We start now!
JENNA?!?
Karen...
I'LL KILL YOU! YOU HEAR ME!?
The fuck you will!
Not a chance.
GO JENNA! WE'LL HOLD HER OFF.
She's right. We need to go. We have our part to play.
But... fight...
We're with you.
RUNNING WITH HER TAIL BETWEEN HER LEGS! LEAVING YOU ALL FOR DEAD. YOUR LITTLE RESISTANCE IS NOTHING BUT ASHES. JUST GIVE UP.
My Resistance doesn't give up.
My Resistance doesn't break.
My Resistance NEVER burns out.
MY RESISTANCE HOLDS THE LINE!
HOLD THE LINE!
LET'S KICK HER FIRE ASS!
Insignificant vermin.
Jenna! Let's go!
Right.
